SECTION: 1. Purpose And Scope

1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
This endorsement provides limited coverage for loss caused by water which backs up through sewers or drains, or which overflows or is discharged from a sump, sump pump or related equipment. Loss of this kind is excluded under Form HO-0304 by exclusion E-19 and is covered only to the extent set out here.

SECTION: 5. Limits, Sublimits And Deductible

5. LIMITS, SUBLIMITS AND DEDUCTIBLE
5.1 The most we will pay for any one water damage loss under this endorsement is the Coverage A limit shown in the declarations, less the deductible in Clause 5.3.
5.2 Our total liability for mould, fungus or wet rot resulting from a covered water damage loss is limited to ten thousand dollars ($10,000) in any one policy year, regardless of the number of losses or claimants. This sublimit is part of, and not in addition to, the Coverage A limit.
